newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares ease, short-term outlook bleak.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares ease, short-term outlook bleak.

text.p: Estonian shares eased in slightly more active trade on Tuesday and dealers said the market was expected to remain sluggish at least for the short-term.
Total trade on the main list was a reasonable 31.9 million kroons with the Talse 1.47 percent lower at 246.53.
"It is reaching the point where trades of one million kroons seem big," one dealer said. "The downward trend is expected to stay for the time being."
Amid what is a prolonged period of calmness, dealers said investor interest seemed to be low at the moment due to the impending summer period.
The market is also being driven by local players at the moment with foreign activity seen as limited.
Dealers said more interest may emerge when a crop of expected new listings hits the market, including ski-maker Viisnurk, car dealer Fakto and Viru Rand.
Hansapank was most active, shedding 2.05 kroons to close at 125.50 kroons on trade of 9.4 million kroons.
The free market turned over 3.3 million kroons with most stocks lower.
"The free market is following the main list but with far less liquidity," another dealer said.
